CommunityApplications.Profile:
This repository maintains the Unraid Community Applications template for **MetaTana**, an AI-powered media manager for the library you already own.
Point MetaTana at a folder and it identifies every movie, show, and anime title using AI vision and trusted metadata providers, then enriches everything with artwork, subtitles, trailers, cast, and crew. It renames and organizes files into a clean, consistent structure and writes sidecar metadata your player can read.
MetaTana is metadata-only and downloader-agnostic. It works alongside any media library and any player, including Plex, Jellyfin, Kodi, and Emby.
**Support:** https://github.com/metatana/support/discussions — or email support@watari.dev
**Unraid setup guide:** https://metatana.com/install/unraid
